authority: This file is the canonical ENVIRONMENT + STORY PLAN authority for story the_charm_001, in the same way brand/nyx_identity/identity_spec.json is the canonical IDENTITY authority. story_continuity.py loads it at run time; nothing hand-writes per-slide prompts from it. identity_lock.authority: HIGHEST. Canonical Nyx identity is immutable and is never overridden by a previous slide, by this story's environment, or by a model's styling preference.
identity_lock.never_from_previous_slides: A previously generated slide may inform WHAT IS HAPPENING. It is never evidence for WHO NYX IS.

environment_lock.status_note: PROVISIONAL until slide 1 is approved; the approved slide 1 image then becomes the immutable environment/wardrobe master for the whole story (status LOCKED) and is supplied on EVERY later slide, not just the next one.
environment_lock.summary: Nyx's own small apartment bedroom at night -- the room she personally calls her den. Describe the physical room, never the bare word 'den'.

anchors.description: a small, intimate, lived-in one-person apartment bedroom; the bed takes up a substantial share of the floor space
dark charcoal bedding with one large charcoal pillow
a warm salt-lamp-style bedside lamp on a dark bedside table -- the main light source at night
a desk with a monitor, set behind/near the bed area in the same small room
trailing green plants around the desk and the wall above it
a moon/celestial poster and a casual photo collage on the wall
a night window with ordinary city buildings visible outside
cozy, ordinary and slightly cluttered -- a real person's bedroom, not a styled set
an old dark wooden trunk, half-buried under boxes near the desk -- physically present in the room from slide 1, long before it becomes the subject

environment_lock.geometry_rule: Room geometry, furniture placement and decor are IDENTICAL in every slide. Only the camera and Nyx move. A new composition is a new camera position in this same room -- never a different, bigger or redesigned room.
environment_lock.vocabulary_rule: Never describe the location as just 'her den'. The bare word has been reinterpreted by generation models as a fantasy/luxury set; always emit the physical anchors above.
forbidden: luxury, upscale, penthouse, loft or hotel-suite reinterpretation
a larger, more spacious or higher-ceilinged room than the approved slide 1
ornate or designer furniture, chandelier, marble, velvet, decorative mouldings
a polished/styled apartment-tour or interiors-magazine look
fantasy set dressing, magical props, glowing runes, floating objects
redesigning, re-decorating or re-laying-out the room between slides
removing an environment anchor because the camera moved

wardrobe_lock.outfit: the same fitted black T-shirt and grey lounge pants in every slide of this story
wardrobe_lock.hair: the same hairstyle as the approved slide 1, unchanged for the whole story
wardrobe_lock.time_of_day: night in every slide, lit by the bedside lamp
forbidden: an outfit, hairstyle or time-of-day change that the story never states

retry.rule: A critical identity/environment/continuity failure rejects ONLY that slide and retries from the SAME approved state. A rejected image never mutates story state. Approved slides are never regenerated to fix a later slide.
